+def storage_key_from_ref(ref: str) -> str | None:
+    """
+    Map a user-settable image reference to an object key in our storage.
+
+    Accepts a relative key ("cuts/<id>/<uuid>.png") or a full URL under
+    settings.STORAGE_HOST (what the API hands out). Returns None for anything
+    else, e.g. URLs pointing at other hosts. Never performs a network request.
+    """
+    from urllib.parse import urlsplit, unquote
+
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    ref = ref.strip()
+
+    host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").rstrip("/")
+    if host and ref.startswith(host + "/"):
+        rest = ref[len(host) + 1:]
+        key = unquote(urlsplit("/" + rest).path).lstrip("/")
+    else:
+        parts = urlsplit(ref)
+        # Any scheme or network location means a foreign address.
+        if parts.scheme or parts.netloc or ref.startswith("//") or "\\" in ref:
+            return None
+        key = ref.lstrip("/")
+
+    if not key or any(seg in ("", ".", "..") for seg in key.split("/")):
+        return None
+    return key
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(ref: str) -> bytes | None:
+    """
+    Load image bytes for a user-settable reference without ever requesting a
+    user-supplied address: data: URLs are decoded locally and storage
+    keys/URLs are read through the storage client. Anything else gives None.
+    """
+    import base64
+
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    if ref.startswith("data:"):
+        try:
+            header, encoded = ref.split(",", 1)
+        except ValueError:
+            return None
+        if ";base64" not in header:
+            return None
+        try:
+            return base64.b64decode(encoded)
+        except Exception:
+            return None
+
+    key = storage_key_from_ref(ref)
+    if key is None:
+        print(f"[Storage] Refusing to load image from non-storage address: {ref[:100]}")
+        return None
+    return storage.download_image(key)

+"""Exports name the cuts they leave out: `missing.txt` in the ZIP and the
+`X-Missing-Cuts` header on both formats."""
+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG, FakeMinio
+
+DATA_PNG = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode()
+NOT_AN_IMAGE = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(b"not a png").decode()
+
+
+def _episode(client, h, image_paths):
+    """Creates an episode whose cut N (1-based) has image_paths[N-1]."""
+    ws = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]
+    p = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": [], "workspace_id": ws["id"]})
+    assert p.status_code == 200, p.text
+    e = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": p.json()["id"], "episode_order": 1})
+    assert e.status_code == 200, e.text
+    episode_id = e.json()["id"]
+    for order, path in enumerate(image_paths, start=1):
+        c = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": order, "image_path": path})
+        assert c.status_code == 200, c.text
+    return episode_id
+
+
+def _export(client, h, episode_id, fmt):
+    return client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={fmt}", headers=h)
+
+
+def test_zip_lists_missing_cuts(client):
+    from app.core.config import settings
+
+    FakeMinio.objects.setdefault(settings.MINIO_BUCKET, {})["cuts/a/ok.png"] = PNG
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode(
+        client,
+        h,
+        [
+            DATA_PNG,                               # 1 ok
+            None,                                   # 2 no image yet
+            "http://169.254.169.254/latest/",       # 3 refused address
+            "cuts/a/does-not-exist.png",            # 4 cannot be loaded
+            "cuts/a/ok.png",                        # 5 ok
+        ],
+    )
+    r = _export(client, h, episode_id, "zip")
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4"
+    zf = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content))
+    assert zf.read("missing.txt").decode().splitlines() == ["2", "3", "4"]
+    pngs = sorted(n for n in zf.namelist() if n.endswith(".png"))
+    assert pngs == ["Ep_1_01.png", "Ep_1_05.png"]
+
+
+def test_zip_without_missing_cuts_has_no_list_or_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, [DATA_PNG, DATA_PNG])
+    r = _export(client, h, episode_id, "zip")
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
+    names = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)).namelist()
+    assert "missing.txt" not in names
+    assert len(names) == 2
+
+
+def test_webtoon_reports_missing_cuts_in_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, [None, DATA_PNG, "http://10.0.0.5/x.png", NOT_AN_IMAGE, DATA_PNG])
+    r = _export(client, h, episode_id, "webtoon")
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["content-type"] == "image/png"
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "1,3,4"
+
+
+def test_webtoon_without_missing_cuts_has_no_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, [DATA_PNG, DATA_PNG])
+    r = _export(client, h, episode_id, "webtoon")
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
+
+
+def test_missing_cuts_header_is_exposed_to_browsers(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, [DATA_PNG, None])
+    r = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip",

+    )

+    assert "x-missing-cuts" in r.headers["access-control-expose-headers"].lower()
